best_gains.units: Kp: duty/(rad/s), Ki: duty/(rad/s*s), Kd: duty*s/(rad/s)

engineering_justification: Lowest experimental overshoot (31.2% vs 71.5% in PSO and 91.4% in PIDTUNE).
Gentle actuator effort: Duty peak is only 45.2% in simulation and stays within 40.7-66.7% in physical hardware without H-bridge saturation.
Zero reverse braking demand: Protects TB6612 MOSFETs and prevents hydraulic shock / cavitation in the silicone tubing.
Strict compliance with ASCE/EWRI 2-22 clean-water reaeration testing zero overshoot imperative.
